subject_line: 130 Articles, 50 Blood Tests, and BBQ Season Is Here
opening: Hey friends — we just crossed 130 published articles in the library, which is wild to think about. Big news on our end: newsletters now come from mail.carnivoreweekly.com (our own domain, finally). This week we've got pieces on partners thinking you've joined a cult, electrolyte fixes, the seed oil wars, beef organ supplements, and a full carnivore travel playbook. Oh, and summer's here — which means BBQ season is basically a carnivore holiday. Let's get into it.

blog_teasers.title: What Happens When Your Partner Thinks You've Joined a Cult
blog_teasers.teaser: Relationship tension posts are spiking on r/carnivore. Here's what the friction actually looks like, why it happens, and how couples are working through it.

blog_teasers.title: Bridal Season, My First Etsy Sale, and a Wish
blog_teasers.teaser: An Etsy email about bridal season sent me back to my own wedding. Here's what I wish someone had told me about inflammation, energy, and feeling good on the big day.

blog_teasers.title: I Cheated. Now What? The Carnivore Re-Entry Protocol
blog_teasers.teaser: You ate the carbs. Here's what actually happened and the exact steps to get back on track fast — without the guilt spiral.

Views on Top Video This Week
whats_trending:
Carnivore MD vs. Big Pharma: Dr. Paul Saladino went on Valuetainment (174K views) breaking down what he calls the pharmaceutical industry's war on meat-based nutrition. It's spicy, it's controversial, and the comment section is a warzone.

"Carnivore Wasn't Enough": HomeSteadHow dropped a brutally honest video (64K views) about how strict carnivore tanked their health and what they changed. Refreshing to see someone talk about what didn't work instead of just the highlight reel.

50 Patients, One Shocking Result: Dr. Abs tested bloodwork on 50 carnivore patients and one finding changed his clinical approach entirely (55K views). Won't spoil it — but it's not what you'd expect.
community_pulse: The community lit up this week after Dr. Abs shared blood work results from 50 carnivore patients — and the findings challenged a lot of assumptions about what happens to your lipid panel on this way of eating. It's the kind of real-world data we don't see enough of, and it lines up with what we've been breaking down in our own deep dive on cholesterol changes after 90 days. The other big conversation? Electrolytes. It's still the #1 question from people starting out, and for good reason — getting sodium, potassium, and magnesium wrong can make the first few weeks miserable. If that's you, you're not alone, and the science behind why it happens is actually pretty straightforward once someone explains it.
looking_ahead: Next week we're dropping fresh posts on summer carnivore strategies — think grilling protocols, staying consistent when the routine breaks, and meal prep for hot weather. We just switched to a custom email domain, which means these newsletters should land in your inbox more reliably. Got questions or topics you want us to cover? Just hit reply.
